title: [SEP2-9] The SFrame KID gives the SFU a stable per-member pseudonym and epoch-change signal; §6.6 w
description: Review finding SEP2-9: The SFrame KID gives the SFU a stable per-member pseudonym and epoch-change signal; §6.6 wrongly calls this within budget items 1-2 (lens SEP2). Location: spec/06-calls.md:186, :191, :222; ARCHITECTURE.md:149-157. Fix: As suggested. Item 2 lists only envelope routing fields, while the KID (06:222, RFC 9605 §5.2) carries `sender_index` (the MLS leaf index, stable across calls in the group) and `epoch % 16`, which reveals MLS epoch changes that 12.4 otherwise keeps from IOs. Add the KID to ARCHITECTURE §5 (an SFU item), add the §9 sentence, and correct the 06:191 citation. The KID format comes from RFC 9605 and is not something to redesign. Full text: notes/review2/SEP2-verified.md and notes/review2/SEP2.md.
